headline: Can Trump continue with Iran war despite funding restrictions?
standfirst: A Congress budget bill could serve as a pressure tactic on Trump to end the war but could also cause a government shutdown.
label: EXPLAINER
subheadings: Can Democrats use the funding bill to end the war on Iran?
Could Trump veto a bill that cuts all military spending?
What happens if a Democrat bill isn’t vetoed? Would that end the war?
Is there a precedent for Congress using funding to end wars?
paragraphs: As US Democrats prepare to assume control of both houses of Congress in January following victory in the midterm elections, the issue of ending the war on Iran is back in sharp focus.

A new budget bill is in the works and could serve as a pressure tactic on Trump if it limits funding for the war. So what are Trump’s options now?
